Interface GuardrailValidator

All Known Subinterfaces:
CustomGuardrailValidator, SanitizingValidator
All Known Implementing Classes:
BiasValidator, InputLengthValidator, InputSecretValidator, OutputContentValidator, PiiSanitizingValidator, PromptInjectionValidator, SemanticValidator, ToxicityValidator
public interface GuardrailValidator
Contract for a single step in the guardrail validation chain.

Implementations must be thread-safe and stateless.

  • Method Details

    • name

      String name()
      Unique machine-readable name (e.g. "BIAS", "PII").

    • order

      int order()
      Execution order — lower values run first.
      • 0–99 : structural checks (length)
      • 100–199 : hard-block detectors (bias, injection)
      • 200–299 : sanitisers (PII)
      • 300–399 : soft warnings (toxicity)
      • 900+ : custom / team-specific

    • validate

      List<Violation> validate(String text, GuardrailContext context)
      Validate the text and return any violations found.
      Parameters:
      text - current prompt (may be modified by earlier validators)
      context - pipeline context
      Returns:
      violations (empty = no issues)

    • isEnabled

      default boolean isEnabled()
      Whether this validator is enabled. Default true.
